comments.note: The Developer's CJS decision for install-hooks.js is confirmed correct and well-reasoned. All 7 files in scripts/ use require() — there are no ESM import statements at the top level in any of them. The WP's 'must use ESM' specification was factually wrong. Transparent flagging in the implementation debt comment is good practice. Future PM-authored WPs touching scripts/ should check the actual module format before specifying it.

pre-commit hook portability: git always invokes hooks with CWD set to the repository root, so 'node scripts/build-personas.js --check' will resolve correctly regardless of which subdirectory the developer ran 'git commit' from. The implementation is correct.

install-hooks.js uses execSync with { stdio: 'inherit' } which correctly forwards git output. Since execSync throws on non-zero exit (git config error), no explicit error handling is needed. The single console.log confirmation message is the right lightweight feedback pattern.
